AdjustmentReason.description: Reason code required on every stock adjustment.

AlertLevel.description: Stock level of an item at a facility, derived from its thresholds.

AlertType.description: Kind of alert on the dashboard.

DiscrepancyAction.description: Actions a user may take on a discrepancy (its allowed_actions).

DiscrepancyResolution.description: How a discrepancy was resolved, with the stock effect each one has.

DiscrepancyStatus.description: Whether a shipment shortfall is still unresolved.

FacilityType.description: Kind of facility in the supply chain.

LineStatus.description: Status of one item line inside a resupply request.

MovementAction.description: Actions a user may take on a ledger row (listed in its allowed_actions).

MovementType.description: Why a row was appended to the stock ledger.

RequestAction.description: Actions a user may take on a resupply request (its allowed_actions).

RequestStatus.description: Lifecycle of a resupply request (derived from its lines where relevant).

Role.description: What a user may do at a facility.

SeedProfile.description: Which fictional dataset the test-only seed endpoint loads.

ShipmentAction.description: Actions a user may take on a shipment (its allowed_actions).

StockBucket.description: Which balance a ledger row changes. Quarantine and release post one row to each.

WarningCode.description: Non-fatal notes the API can attach to a successful response (meta.warnings).
